description: This class includes the repair and maintenance of industrial electrical equipment.
includes: repair and maintenance of electric motors, generators and transformers
repair and maintenance of electricity distribution and control apparatus
repair and maintenance of industrial and commercial electric lighting equipment
repair and maintenance of batteries and accumulators
repair and maintenance of wiring devices
repair of electric household appliances (non-consumer — industrial grade)
excludes: repair of domestic electrical appliances (household), see 9522
repair of electrical wiring in buildings, see 4321
